description: Traffic Lane Vehicle Counts at Signalised Intersections and Pedestrian Crossings (sample) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. The lane count data for Signalised Intersections and Pedestrian Crossings from 8 June 2017 to 14 June 2017. Behind the stop line at most signalised location there are loops that detect vehicle presence in each lane and they can provide an approximate count of vehicles. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are SCATS, count, crossing, intersection, lane. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2017-08-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
